logging {
    level  = "info"
    format = "json"
}

import.file "webtop_processor" {
  filename = "/etc/alloy/bt-alloy/webtop_processor.alloy"
}

webtop_processor.webtop_filter "webtop_log_processing" {
    logfilename = "/opt/imail/log/webtop/mail/analytics.log"
    log_receiver = [loki.write.prd_endpoint.receiver]
}

loki.write "prd_endpoint" {
    endpoint {
        url = "https://loki-aa-test-deployed-domain.com/loki/api/v1/push"
        max_backoff_retries = 5
    }
    external_labels = {}
}
